concept.hr: Ton jedne postaje je miran, a svaka crta druge raste od pritiska tipke
concept.en: One station's tone is steady; every dah of the other rises from key-down

summary.hr: Snimka stvarne CW veze u dva prolaza s izmjerenom visinom tona: crte prve postaje su ravne, a crte druge rastu oko 30 Hz.
summary.en: A recording of a real CW contact in two passes with its measured pitch: the first station's dahs are flat, the second's rise by about 30 Hz.

what.hr: Aplet applet_chirp_2.html sa snimkom CW veze između RA1OW i OM3YCY i njezinim prijepisom, te tekst o naponskoj stabilnosti oscilatora (50ohm.de, odjeljak oszillator_spannungsstabilitaet, hrvatski prijevod)
what.en: The applet applet_chirp_2.html with its recording of a CW contact between RA1OW and OM3YCY and its transcript, and the text on the oscillator's voltage stability (50ohm.de, section oszillator_spannungsstabilitaet, Croatian translation)

changes.hr: Prilagođen simdeck kitu, preveden na engleski, dodane krivulje visine tona izmjerene iz snimke i usporedba crta obaju prolaza
changes.en: Adapted to the simdeck kit, translated into English, pitch curves measured from the recording and a comparison of both passes' dahs added
